index.html.title: Nonprofit Grant Finder | Search Funding Opportunities
index.html.description: Search GrantFinder’s nonprofit grant database, compare eligibility and funder requirements, and follow the original program source before applying.
index.html.heading: Choose a grant opportunity by eligibility and fit
index.html.body:
Start with the grant database and narrow the research to your nonprofit’s mission, geography and project. Use each funder’s original source to confirm current eligibility, dates, application instructions and any required match.

Compare federal and foundation funding and review proposal preparation before investing time in an application. A database listing does not establish that funding remains open or that an applicant will receive an award.
